chunks: Abu Usāmah narrated that he asked him about a man who reached the Imam while he was bowing; he said:
"If he pronounces the takbir, straightens his back, then bows, he has caught up."

key_terms.أَدْرَكَ: caught up with or attained the rak'ah
key_terms.الْإِمَامِ: the prayer leader in congregational salat
key_terms.رَاكِعٌ: being in the state of ruku' (bowing)
key_terms.صُلْبَهُ: his back, meaning his posture was straightened

ai.seo_question: How does a person catch the rak'ah if he joins the Imam while the Imam is in ruku'?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling about joining congregational salat when the Imam is already in ruku'. It states that if the person says the takbir, stands upright properly, and then performs ruku', he is considered to have caught the rak'ah.
